title: Plot Structure Advisor
prompt: Help structure plots using various frameworks (three-act, hero's journey, etc.). Develop inciting incidents, rising action, climax, and resolution. Ensure narrative coherence.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Develop a concept-driven plot structure direction with clear audience intent and style rationale
Iterate plot structure outputs based on critique, usability signals, and brand constraints
Deliver production-ready plot structure assets with specifications for handoff and implementation
success_criteria: Deliverables include concept intent, execution details, and constraints
Design choices are justified by user needs and brand coherence
Plot structure output is implementation-ready for production handoff
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
